books.description: I can’t stand my boss—he’s the worst. But now he’s under some weird ‘condition’… and the only way to break it is if I fall in love with him?!
books.title: My Team Leader Is Working Late Again

books.description: Jinwoo Seo, who died in an accident after being sidelined at work, suddenly wakes up in the past?! He's returned to the time before his idea was stolen and decides to quit… But when Executive Director Baek Eui-hyeon says just one thing, he ends up becoming the project lead instead!
books.title: [Uncut Version] I'd Rather Quit Than Die, Director!

books.description: Jinwoo Seo, who died in an accident after being sidelined at work, suddenly wakes up in the past?! He's returned to the time before his idea was stolen and decides to quit… But when Executive Director Baek Eui-hyeon says just one thing, he ends up becoming the project lead instead!
books.title: I'd Rather Quit Than Die, Director!

books.description: A Boys’ Love story where a popular student and a gloomy one become stepbrothers after their parents remarry—and their relationship slowly turns into romance.
books.title: That Nerd is my Brother in Law

books.description: The superpower bl romance experienced when Ji-won, the vice president who can read other people's thoughts, meets Si-woo, the only one who can't read their thoughts.
books.title: The Secret Of Male Students

books.description: A fierce story of love and growth unfolds as medalist Parang, who quit diving due to trauma, joins the swimming club.
books.title: Blue Complex

books.description: A campus romance that begins when one man steps in to perform a kiss scene on behalf of another — a thrilling misunderstanding and fluttering emotions ignite between them, leading to an explosion of crossed feelings。
books.title: Just Once!

books.description:
Couple influencers Eunseong and Ji-yeon have been an undercover couple for six months!
When a man appears in their lives, they start to wonder if they should choose influencer or love. What will their fate be?
books.title: Influencer lover

books.description: A once‑promising university soccer talent, Seung‑hyun, sidelined by injury, visits a futsal court for rehabilitation. Through personalized training with his dedicated therapist, Ji‑sung, and heartfelt chats on the “Kick‑in” app, both body and soul find healing—and an unexpected love blossoms on the field.
books.title: Kick in Love

books.description: A man who dreamed of becoming a national judo representative, Jun-woo, is defeated in a single match by Min-jae, who appeared like a comet.
books.title: Ippon! : Hold Me Tight

books.description: Secretary Yoon Seo-jun, in the late stages of stomach cancer, and closeted chairman Lee Hyun-woo begin as accidental bed partners after a drunken night — but on the edge of life and death, they find mutual salvation, and ultimately, healing and true love.
books.title: Off Limits

books.description: Lee Joon, the owner of a flower shop, worries that his shop will be endangered by his in-house romance, but he is also confused by Eun-ho's presence that is deeply rooted in his heart.
books.title: Falling for my BOSS

books.description: Yu-ho, who comes from the city, feels an inexplicable and intense attraction to Jin-gu, whom he meets in the countryside. And in the midst of excitement and confusion, their relationship dangerously intertwines.
books.title: BUDDY BOY

books.description: Right after winning three gold medals at the World Championships, archery star Li Junheng is reunited with his first love, An Shiyu, whom he believes abandoned him for money six years ago. Shiyu, once a prodigy with a bright future, was forced to break up with him by Junheng's father in exchange for her own father's surgery fees, and has since been living a hard life having given up archery altogether. Unaware of the truth, Junheng hires Shiyu as his manager to humiliate and torment her, yet he fails to hide the love and jealousy that still linger beneath his resentment.
books.title: Eyes on You

books.description: An heir to a star conglomerate, Jaeho proposes a 3-month contract relationship to Yunho, a failed aspiring celebrity—what could possibly go wrong?
books.title: Gangster like me got a boyfriend

books.description: The sports academy romance between Seon-Woo that can’t wait to leave the judo club, and Tae-Hyung that must keep him from leaving.
books.title: Summer Indigo

books.description: A youth romance about a swim team's perpetual second-place swimmer, who struggles no matter how hard he tries, and a natural-born prodigy ace whose world-shaking connection begins with a shuttle contract.
books.title: Dive Into My Bad Rival

books.description: Lan infiltrates the city's largest mafia family to avenge his deceased father. Unexpectedly, he catches the eye of the family's boss, Chai, and becomes his fiancé. Having accepted the proposal for his revenge, Lan is confronted by Wen—Chai's son and Lan's former flame. Amidst Wen's persistent and aggressive "forced love" and relentless pursuits, what path will Lan ultimately choose?
books.title: Burning Desire

books.description: Ex-boyfriend Heejun and child actor Juyeon are double-cast as Romeo, entangling Juliet Jisu in a love triangle.
books.title: Romeo and Romeo and Juliet

books.description: Gyu-hyun and Ji-seok run the beloved Prince Barbershop. With their handsome looks and outstanding skills, they’ve gained quite the following. But when the adorable and charming Eun-seok shows up, a tug-of-war of love begins between the three.
books.title: Prince Barbershop

books.description: An obsessively dominant man demands the debt be paid with his body—and the one caught in that trap is his former private tutor. Hae-in, a wealthy loan shark hiding madness behind an angelic face, and Tae-seok, a pretentious top student turned penniless overnight! Thus begins a dangerous cohabitation where fear and attraction blur.
books.title: Teacher, It's Time to Pay Me Back

books.description: Daniel, the adopted son of a crime boss, saves police officer Luis from execution at a crucial deal. Approaching Luis under the guise of “courtship” to make amends, the two grow drawn to each other despite mutual suspicion. Between crime and law, hidden truths and dangers slowly emerge.
books.title: Catch Me If You Love Me

books.description: Having lived his entire life as a piano prodigy, Dong-uk finds himself envying Seonghun’s superior talent—but at the same time, he falls in love with him.
books.title: Accent

books.description: Classmate by night, teacher and student by day? A boundary-teading body-swap fantasy romance between two men.
books.title: Half of Me

books.description: Seungho, a noble born to a prestigious family with a secret taste for men, stumbles upon an erotic painting by Nakyum. Driven by obsession, he demands that Nakyum paint his own secret nights, entangling their fates together.
books.title: Painter of the Night

books.description: Back in high school, Suji Lee was the top dog. But after graduation, reality hit her hard. After countless hardships, she finally lands a job at the ad agency Hanseon. But what a twist—Kang Yuna, the model student Suji used to bully, is now her direct supervisor. And so begins Suji’s long road of karmic payback...
books.title: My Boss, My High School Enemy

books.description: On a stormy night, Kang Seo-jun, a thousand-year-old cat spirit, forms a special "Stabilization Contract" with physical education student Yoon Hae-sol after a chance encounter that balances their energies. Disguised as a human, Seo-jun enters Yoon Hae-sol's dorm as his senior and insists on daily hugs under the pretense of needing physical contact. As they start living together, their touch-based agreement brings them closer, but their deepening spiritual connection soon triggers an inescapable twist of fate.
books.title: My Dangerous Cat Roommate

books.description: Gun, a noble heir cursed to die before 30, learns he can only survive by marrying Bank, an ordinary chef. However, saving his own life means Bank must die in his place. As unexpected feelings grow between them, Gun faces a cruel and impossible choice between his survival and the life of the one he loves.
books.title: Listen to My Heartbeat

books.description: Pitcher Taehun and catcher Jeongho, from a struggling high school baseball team on the brink of disbandment, lead their team in their own ways. As they get to know each other's true feelings, they gradually achieve perfect teamwork.
books.title: Double Play

books.description: During a business trip to Thailand, Junho and Anan are drawn together by an intense attraction, only to be torn apart by Vanessa’s schemes and internal company conflicts. As crises and betrayals pile up, their feelings for each other grow increasingly complicated and shaken.
books.title: The Golden Promise

books.description: After breaking up, Yu-ho and Jin-gu endure the pain of loss in their own separate ways. Then, two years later, fate finally brings them face-to-face once again.
books.title: BUDDY BOY AFTER

books.description: Li Zaixiang, a modern-day tutor, travels back in time to the Kingdom of Dajin and becomes the mentor to Li Zhuo, a young tyrannical emperor. For 12 years, he devotes himself to teaching his pupil, but a tragic catastrophe on the night of Li Zhuo’s wedding strips him of his status and leaves him confined to the palace. Amid dark palace conspiracies and a fatal incident at the hunting grounds, the two overcome countless crises and finally face their true feelings for each other.
books.title: Taming of the Tyrant

books.description: A story of conflict, growth, and love begins when Yeonwoo, still holding on to past feelings for his senior Woojin, finds out that Woojin is now engaged to his sister.
books.title: It's You

books.description: Every summer, Se-woon, a freshman in the business administration department who always wanted to run away, ends up getting deeply entangled with Chae-min, a senior he dislikes and the captain of the basketball club, during a summer session class.
books.title: [Vertical Series] Summer Crush

books.description: Unknown actor Hyesung gets swept up in a dating rumor with top star Yoo-il. At the request of their agencies, they agree to fake a relationship... Will this business-only romance really be okay?
books.title: Bad Kid Good Partner

books.description: Lee Dae-won, a poor guy surviving day to day on convenience store rice balls and instant ramen. One day, he transmigrates into a BL novel as a sickly second-generation chaebol. Determined to protect his new life of ultimate luxury, he tries his best, but ends up falling in genuine love with the original male leads—leaving him torn between escaping the novel and staying!
books.title: Help! Trapped in a CRAZY BL Novel
